Iris (docs): quick heads up 1 opened a docs PR to add a short guide on alerting for sudden cost spikes in dashboards and to fix a Ruby SDK snippet that used the old trace flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6422
Alan (eng-obsv): nice. what's in the guide?
Iris (docs): short checklist: choose metric (cost_per_token or total_tokens_cost), set a rolling-window (5m/1h), threshold type (absolute vs pct increase), and add a tracing-hook example to capture sampled per-key traces when an alert fires.
Pri (devex): can you paste the tracing-hook snippet? i'll validate in the playground and capture the trace timeline.
Iris (docs): pasted Ruby tracing-hook example:
```ruby
# tracing hook to attach sampled per-key span on cost spike
client.on_alert("cost_spike") do |alert|
  key = alert.payload["kv.key"] || alert.payload["kv_key"]
  client.create_span(name: "sampled_per_key", attrs: {"kv.key": key}, sampled: true)
end
```
Rory (sdk): heads-up: Ruby SDK v1.2 renamed `create_span` kwargs to use symbol keys (`:sampled` -> `sampled:`) — the example is fine, but we should show the modern style and include the `include_cost_breakdown` flag sample for Python too. i'll open a micro PR to update the snippet formatting.
Alan (eng-obsv): wording suggestion for the guide: "For transient spikes, prefer a percentage-over-baseline alert (e.g., >200% over 1h baseline). For sustained high cost, use absolute thresholds. Attach a sampled per-key trace on alert to investigate outliers."
Iris (docs): added that wording under "Recommended thresholds".
Marta (product): please add a short note on billing windows: alerts evaluate on telemetry ingestion time; if you have delayed exports, use a longer window or annotation to avoid false positives.
Iris (docs): added billing-window note.
Pri (devex): validated Ruby snippet in the console playground, screenshots attached in PR. small UI quirk: alert preview uses latest sample only; documented as "preview shows latest sample, not full triggered window".
Rory (sdk): opened SDK micro-PR to polish the Ruby example and add a Python example showing `include_cost_breakdown=True`: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512
ci-bot: docs preview passed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/6422
Alan (eng-obsv): one migration note: older exports used `kv_key` flat field; new telemetry uses `kv.key`. added a jq snippet to map old -> new in the migration section.
Iris (docs): added migration bash snippet: `jq '.events[] |= (. + {"kv.key": .kv_key})' old-export.json > new-export.json` and a compatibility note: "Dashboards will show `unknown` for missing fields."
Marta (product): approved copy; good to ship as a patch.
Iris (docs): thanks all 1 will merge once SDK snippet PR lands and preview updates. planning to include in next minor docs release.
thread_summary: Docs PR coordination to add an alerting guide for cost spikes, add a tracing-hook sample (Ruby), and sync SDK snippets and migration notes.
